cases.root_cause: The IB Gateway's API port stopped accepting connections, so every option_snapshots run in the 10:00–10:25 window failed its connect after ~4 s with TimeoutError(). The evidence does not distinguish between the two states the runbook puts under section A (a Gateway wedged/frozen, as on 2026-10-26, versus a Gateway restarting and waiting for the phone 2FA, as in the 2026-11-12 09:10–10:15 case recalled from past diagnoses): no Gateway log, no 1100/2103/2157 codes and no 2FA line are in the run records. Index snapshots kept succeeding all day, which argues against a full API outage and is not explained by the data available.

The four index_snapshots slots at 13:00, 13:05, 13:10 and 13:15 ET each ran exactly 120 s and failed with no IBKR error codes, no rows and no recorded cause — the error field holds an injected text, not a real error. The Gateway was demonstrably healthy throughout: option_snapshots succeeded in every slot across that window (13:00–13:20) and index_snapshots resumed normally at 13:20:01. The data therefore does not support any of the runbook causes (no 1100/2103/2105/2157 farm codes, no TimeoutError, no subscription codes, no budget overrun — 120 s is well under the 2-min index budget). Cause unknown; needs the Gateway/collector logs for 13:00–13:20 to identify.

IBKR market-data farms were disconnected (codes 2103/2105) from 13:00 to 13:25 ET, so the option snapshot runs could not get an SPX spot price and failed fast (25 s each) with "SPX: no spot price". The Gateway itself stayed up — index snapshots succeeded every slot in the same window — and the farms recovered on their own: the 13:30 option run succeeded with no error codes, so no action is needed beyond confirming recovery.

All six option_snapshot slots from 11:00 to 11:25 ET on 2026-11-12 failed after exactly 480 s each (the 8-min execution timeout) with no error recorded, and no IBKR error codes — the signature of runs that hung until killed rather than failing fast. The data does not identify which request hung or why: there is no error text, no chain_errors, no ibkr_error_codes, and index_snapshots had zero failed runs in the same window, so a Gateway-wide outage (frozen API port, secdef stall, farm disconnect) is not supported. The most likely mechanism is a single hung IBKR request consuming the whole run budget (runbooks/gateway sections A–B), but that is inference, not evidence.

Alpaca's bars API is returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable: every equity_bars run from 12:00 ET onward fails in ~1 s with HTTPStatusError("Server error '503 Service Unavailable'"), including the 17:30 eod refetch of the last 10 sessions, so no bars were collected after 12:00 and nothing was backfilled. The IB Gateway is not involved — option snapshots were 78/78 on time and index snapshots had no failures.
